candidate_relations.reason: The pathology confirms a poorly differentiated trophoblastic (choriocarcinoma) tumor, so the histologic characterization is compatible. However, the candidate does not specify the primary adrenal origin nor acknowledge the pulmonary metastases documented on chest CT, both of which are explicit components of the benchmark diagnosis 'Primary Adrenal Choriocarcinoma with pulmonary metastases.'
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the trophoblastic tumor histology but omits the primary adrenal site and the pulmonary metastases components required by the benchmark reference

case_quality_flags: Rare primary adrenal choriocarcinoma; testicular ultrasound negative supports primary adrenal rather than metastatic gonadal origin
Rising β-hCG, trophoblastic histology, and strongly positive β-hCG immunostaining are diagnostically decisive
Numerous pulmonary nodules on chest CT constitute metastatic disease and are a required composite component of the benchmark
